hints.tr: Yeni metin `r"***@\1"`: `\1` alan adını geri koyar.
hints.en: The new text is `r"***@\1"`: `\1` puts the domain back.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
import re


def mask_emails(text):
    return re.sub(r"[\w.]+@([\w.]+)", r"***@\1", text)

print(mask_emails("Mail ada.l@example.com or alan@test.org now"))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
import re


def mask_emails(text):
    return re.sub(r"[\w.]+@([\w.]+)", r"***@\1", text)

print(mask_emails("Mail ada.l@example.com or alan@test.org now"))
```
